question: In July 2024, the 46th session of the World Heritage Committee was held in which of the following locations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Heritage Committee** is responsible for the implementation of the **World Heritage Convention**.
 
• The Committee defines the use of the **World Heritage Fund** and allocates financial assistance upon requests from States Parties.
 
• In **July 2024**, the 46th session of the World Heritage Committee was held in **New Delhi**, India.
 
• **New Delhi** is the capital city of India and is known for its rich **cultural heritage** and significant **historical landmarks**.
 
• The hosting of the session in **New Delhi** highlights India's commitment to preserving and promoting its **cultural and natural heritage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jaipur**__

 __
 
• **Jaipur**, also known as the **Pink City**, is the capital of the Indian state of Rajasthan.
 
• It is famous for its **palaces, forts, and vibrant culture**.
 
• Jaipur is a major tourist destination and has been recognized as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
 
 
• **Indore**__
 __
 
• **Indore** is the largest city in the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its **educational institutions, commercial activity, and vibrant food culture**.
 
• Indore has consistently ranked as one of the **cleanest cities in India**.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru**__
 
 
• **Bengaluru** (also known as Bangalore) is the capital of the Indian state of Karnataka.
 
• It is known as the **Silicon Valley of India** due to its role as the nation's leading information technology (IT) exporter.
 
• Bengaluru is known for its **pleasant climate, parks, and nightlife**.
